Graham Kay's new special, "Pete & Me," is a heartfelt and hilarious journey into his life with his brother, now on Nateland Entertainment's YouTube. Houston, if you love quick, clever, and brilliantly funny comedy, Graham is your guy. His observational humor on family dynamics and personal stories make him a must-see. Catch him live at The Riot Comedy Club on Thursday, September 10, 2026. Link in bio for tickets. Tag someone you'd bring.

Arnez J is back with "Not Gonna Stop," his first special in a decade. Houston, don't miss this. Known for his high-energy, physical style, Arnez J spins family tales and Southern life into pure comedy gold. He’s like Jim Carrey, but with a Southern twist. Expect to laugh until it hurts. Catch Jon Rudnitsky, the guy from 'Saturday Night Live' and 'The Big Leap,' live in Houston. His energy is infectious, and his celebrity impressions are spot on. Think Andy Samberg, but with a Jersey twist. If you love pop culture parodies and sketches, you won't want to miss this.
